kind: Audit-only preservation and accounting of pre-existing reports; no new runtime validation
limitations: No binary/image or source tree copied; their original manifest hashes are retained
Selected control success is not broad conformance
Accounting review does not independently validate each upstream assertion or status classifier
All reports predate the unbuilt source candidate and remain historical
No new runtime tests, probes, compilations or builds were run
